caption: The drawing displays two views of a wooden cylindrical object with a handle. The object on the left is depicted standing upright, showing its cylindrical shape with a slightly wider base and a central handle extending vertically from the top. The color of the object is a light brown with darker shading to indicate the wood texture and contours. On the right side of the drawing, the same object is positioned with the base facing forward, revealing a circular end that is carved with a decorative pattern resembling a diamond-shaped grid surrounded by two leaf-like designs. The background of the drawing is an off-white or cream color, and the shading creates a three-dimensional effect for the objects. There are faint pencil marks and a small handwritten signature in the lower right corner.
title: Pa. German Butter Mold
